title: Company Overview
content_html:
Business is a more moving drama than sports or movies.

People involved in business fight under tremendous pressure every day.

The way they join hands with colleagues, overcome various challenges, and grow is, no less than the athletes we see on TV or the protagonists we see in movies,
a wonderful and dramatic experience.

Through internal events and initiatives, we aim to draw out the wonderful dramas that such hardworking people experience without realizing it themselves,

share the inspiration, and help them recognize that value.

“Work is wonderful!”

We aim to hear such words after the event ends.
